title: SMART-9N amplification enabling rapid nanopore sequencing of RNA viruses
author: Vanessa Smilansky

steps.title: Prepare Viral cDNA and RNA Extracts
steps.instruction: Prepare the starting viral materials in separate clean 0.2 ml tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 5 µL of viral cDNA diluted to 1 ng/µL (total 5 ng). If concentration is <1 ng/µL, increase volume to reach 5 ng; subtract any volume exceeding 5 µL from the 20 µL NFW added in the barcoding step.
Prepare 12 µL of each viral RNA extract.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Convert viral RNA to cDNA using the specified reagents and thermal profile.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of RLB RT 9N (100 µM) to each 0.2 mL tube containing viral RNA extract.
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:05:00, then transfer to ice immediately and keep on ice for 00:02:00.
Add 2 µL of TSOmG (100 µM) followed by 4 µL of LunaScript RT Master Mix Kit (Primer-free) to each tube (total volume 20 µL).
Incubate in thermal cycler using the provided protocol.

steps.title: Perform Sequenase Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using Sequenase master mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Sequenase master mix (adjusted to +10% volume) in a 1.5 mL tube based on sample count; mix by gentle pipetting and brief spin down.
Add 11.2 µL of Sequenase master mix to each sample.
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:08:00.

steps.title: Clean up Sequenase Products
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified products using AMPure XP (AXP) beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AXP beads to resuspend; add 25 µL (0.8X) to each sample and mix by flicking.
Incubate on a Hula mixer at Room temperature for 00:05:00.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet for 00:05:00, then remove supernatant.
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol (keep on magnet), incubate for 00:00:30, and remove ethanol. Repeat this wash.
Dry spin to remove residual ethanol and air dry the pellet on the magnet for approximately 00:00:30 (do not let pellet crack).
Remove tube from magnet and resuspend pellet in 11 µL NFW.
Incubate on a Hula mixer at Room temperature for 00:10:00.
Spin down, pellet on magnet, and transfer 10 µL of eluate to a clean 0.2 mL PCR tube.

steps.title: Quantify and Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Assess the concentration of the purified cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Use 2 µL of each sample to quantify with Qubit dsDNA HS assay.
Reserve the remaining 8 µL for Rapid Barcode PCR (store at -20°C if not used immediately).

steps.title: Perform Rapid Barcode PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify samples with barcodes using the specified cycling conditions.

substeps.instruction: To each tube, add 20 µL NFW (adjusted if cDNA volume was >5 µL), 1 µL Rapid Barcode Primer (RLB01-24, 10 µM), and 25 µL 2X LongAmp Taq Master Mix; mix by flicking and spin down.
Amplify using: 95 °C for 00:00:45; 25 cycles of (95 °C for 00:00:15, 56 °C for 00:00:15, 65 °C for 00:04:00); final extension at 65 °C for 00:06:00; hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Pool Barcoded Samples
steps.instruction: Combine barcoded samples into a single library pool.

substeps.instruction: In a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube, pool all barcoded samples in equal ratios to a combined final concentration of 800 ng (e.g., 80 ng from each of 10 barcodes).

steps.title: Clean up Pooled Library
steps.instruction: Purify the pooled library using AXP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AXP beads; add 0.6X volume of beads to the pooled samples.
Incubate on a Hula mixer at Room temperature for 00:05:00.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet for 00:05:00, then remove supernatant.
Add 500 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol (keep on magnet), incubate for 00:00:30, and remove ethanol. Repeat this wash.
Dry spin to remove residual ethanol and air dry the pellet on the magnet for approximately 00:00:30 (do not let pellet crack).
Remove tube from magnet and resuspend pellet in 14 µL Elution Buffer (EB).
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:02:00.
Spin down, pellet on magnet, and transfer 13 µL of eluate to a clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Final Quantification and Adapter Attachment
steps.instruction: Quantify the final pool and attach adapters for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Use 2 µL of eluate to quantify with Qubit dsDNA HS assay (expected concentration 10–40 ng/µL).
Prepare the Rapid Adapter (RA) dilution in a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube and mix by pipetting.
Add 1 µL of diluted RA to the remaining 11 µL of library pool; mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Load Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Prepare the library for nanopore sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Load the prepared library pool into a MinION/GridION/PromethION Flow Cell. Keep the pool on ice or at 4 °C until loading.
